run_check_doc_toc: run the check_doc_toc script to validate and optionally fix the documentation table of contents
run_clean_doc_toc: run clean_doc_toc to deduplicate and alphabetically sort a documentation entry list
check_scheduler_doc: check the schedulers section of the documentation table of contents for sorting issues
check_pipeline_doc: check the pipelines section of the documentation table of contents for sorting issues
check_model_doc: check the models section of the documentation table of contents for sorting issues
